notes:
Tasks: set reminders when you assign a task, as on the website. Each one goes to the app or by email, a set time before or after the deadline, or repeating until the task is done (every few hours, or daily, weekly or monthly at a set time). They can also be changed while editing a task that has not been accepted yet.

The Recurring tab now has the same floating button as the Tasks tab: New recurring task sits where Assign task does.
